column1: # Fixture for check-issue-label-map.sh (#393): <title><TAB><labels>
# '-' means the rule pass must NOT classify it — those titles are the
# ones that fall through to the model pass, and that fall-through is
# just as much a behaviour worth pinning as a match is.
# Titles are real ones from this repo's history where possible.
# --- type prefixes the rule pass must catch ---
ci: a job no runner picks up never fails — CI hangs silently instead of going red
ci(coverage): a dev merge just before the release PR silently cancels the coverage run
coverage: raise the cmd/net-dhcp floor to 76.0
release: v1.4.0
build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1
test(integration): CI can only ever run one of RestartDockerDaemon two branches
test(harness): instrument per-phase timing
tests: add coverage for the retry budget
fix(plugin): recovery gives up when the daemon is not ready yet
fix: release the lease a container that exited early left behind
feat(plugin): derive the v4 client-id from the MAC
perf(harness): cut container teardown grace
docs: document the local integration run
docs(internals): a lapsed lease is not an event the plugin receives
doc: fix a stale flag name in the reference
refactor(udhcpc): fold the event builder into the client wrapper
# --- must fall through to the model pass ---
Health floor cannot tell an absent counter from a zero one
recovery_failed counts a container that exited before recovery reached it
DHCPv4 lease is not released on a fast docker restart
Support Compose services.*.networks.*.interface_name
Local integration runs are undocumented and can silently test a stale plugin
# --- negatives: a prefix-looking word is not a prefix ---
# No colon, so not a conventional-commit type. These caught a naive '^fix' rule.
fixing the docs would help newcomers
citation needed for the lease-timer claim
testing on the runner is slow
chore(release): v1.3.5 — version pins and release notes
